title: X7 collateral-event slice: consumed operation names, claim and re-appraisal answer shapes, event library row and the legacy AC3 rule condition are not published
source: FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.16 and A1.2; TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T-A, T3.1, T5.3; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DEV-06, R-DEV-12, R-DEV-19; context pack S8 rwb-deviation
description: The APP story of RWB-E7-007 needs six consumed rows - the rwb-case case read and case-move answer, the rwb-decision DEV package read, the rwb-guarantee insurance-claim answer, the rwb-valuation re-appraisal answer and the rwb-source-data collateral read - and no source publishes any of their operation names, so each carries the placeholder. The claim status, the approving identity and the accepted appraisal value have no published property, field ID or list. The step publishes EV-07 DeviationCleared, whose payload the event set gives as caseId, deviationCode and outcome, but the outbox and inbox library of DP-09 (RWB-PLT-TE006-CON) is absent from this key's pattern set and from the plan's H row. The plan's C row is None while six rows are contract dependencies. Legacy AC3 names R-DEV-12, whose own condition is deviation_code = X3 and insurance does not clear, while the story handles X7, and the return to the route decision is also carried by R-DEV-19 on ROUTE_REOPENED; the legacy wording is kept verbatim and both rules are implemented. The plan carries no requirement id for the slice although FSD S8 REQ-S8-005 and REQ-DVH-005 and REQ-DVH-011 cover it.
evidence: TSD S8 T-A.1 publishes API-S8-001 and API-S8-002 only; FSD S8 A2.16.4.4 declares no background event; TSD S8 T5.3 lists DeviationRaised and DeviationCleared as published with no payload schema; split_plan.json slice RWB-S8-E7007-APP carries C [], I [] and reqs []
owner_role: Solution architect, TechX rwb-deviation tech lead, owners of rwb-case, rwb-decision, rwb-guarantee, rwb-valuation and rwb-source-data
proposed: Fix the six operation names and the claim, appraisal and return-point properties in the wave 4 contract review, add the outbox library row RWB-PLT-TE006-CON to the pattern set, and record R-DEV-12 against the X7 return point with the reference to R-DEV-19 in the DEV rule book

title: X7 outcome contract: element properties beyond TSD S8 T3.1 and T-A.2, six consumed operation names and the outbox library row are not published
source: TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T-A.1, T-A.2, T3.1, T3.2, T6.1; FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.16; context pack S8 rwb-deviation
description: TSD S8 T-A.2 publishes the request DeviationOutcome, the answer Deviation, the right U and the error set of API-S8-002, but no property list beyond the deviation columns of T3.1, no return-point property and no required flags for the request. The six consumed rows of the call have no published operation names in any owner document, and the claim status, approving identity and accepted appraisal value have no published property. The published event EV-07 has no schema, so its payload is taken from the event set of the Event and Messaging Design v4. DP-09 and its RWB-PLT-TE006-CON row are absent from the pattern set although the step publishes an event, and the plan's C row is None while six rows are consumed. The split plan carries no requirement id for the contract slice.
evidence: TSD S8 T-A.1 endpoint inventory has two rows with no element schema; TSD S8 T3.2 lists three lists and no other vocabulary; split_plan.json slice RWB-S8-E7007-CON carries C [], I [] and reqs []
owner_role: Solution architect, TechX rwb-deviation tech lead
